narrative.intro: Asrc Federal Facilities Logistics has obligated $514M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Asrc Federal Facilities Logistics has 217,597 awards this year so far and an average award size of $2.4K. Asrc Federal Facilities Logistics obligations are down 31.8% year over year. Asrc Federal Facilities Logistics saw larger obligations in prior fiscal years: FY25 $753M, FY24 $704M, FY23 $714M, FY22 $585M, and FY21 $549M. Asrc Federal Facilities Logistics top markets by NAICS in FY2026 to date include Other Warehousing and Storage $172M and Petroleum Lubricating Oil and Grease Manufacturing $118M, followed by Adhesive Manufacturing $61.2M and Electrical Apparatus and Equipment, Wiring Supplies, and Related Equipment Merchant Wholesalers $59.4M. Asrc Federal Facilities Logistics also has smaller but material activity in All Other Miscellaneous General Purpose Machinery Manufacturing $32M and Paint and Coating Manufacturing $21.8M, with additional activity in Industrial Valve Manufacturing $7.1M and General Warehousing and Storage $7M. The current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date, and the figures above are contract obligations except where noted otherwise.
